text: Offers a read-only, auto-updating bundle install so you subscribe to vendor updates instead of forking the files
quote: installs the whole set as a managed, read-only bundle that updates when I ship, so you subscribe rather than fork

text: Can copy editable skill files directly into your project so you can customize them freely
quote: copies editable skill files into your project, so you can hack on them and make them your own

text: Setup asks which issue tracker to use — GitHub, Linear, or local files
quote: Ask you which issue tracker you want to use (GitHub, Linear, or local files)

text: Provides an explicit `npx skills update` command so nothing changes without your action
quote: Nothing updates behind your back; pull my latest changes when you want them with `npx skills update`.

text: Ships an alignment skill that gets you and the agent to agree on a change before work starts
quote: They help you align with the agent before you get started, and think deeply about the change you're making. Use them _every_ time you want to make a change.

text: Includes a 'grilling' session skill that builds shared language with the AI and records decisions as ADRs
quote: This is built into [`/grill-with-docs`]... It's a grilling session, but that helps you build a shared language with the AI, and document hard-to-explain decisions in ADR's.

text: Enforces a red-green-refactor loop where the agent writes a failing test first, then fixes it
quote: a red-green-refactor loop is critical. This is where the agent writes a failing test first, then fixes the test.

text: Requires tests only at pre-agreed seams, confirmed with the user before any test is written
quote: Test only at pre-agreed seams. Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user.

text: Includes an interview skill that relentlessly questions the user and maps understanding as a design tree
quote: Interview the user relentlessly until you reach a shared understanding. Map this as a **design tree**

text: Moves issues through a triage state machine: categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs
quote: Move issues on the project issue tracker through a small state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

text: Includes a verification step that reproduces a bug from the reporter's steps before grilling the claim
quote: Verify the claim. Before any grilling, check that the claim holds up. For a bug, reproduce it from the reporter's steps.

text: Provides a scaffolding skill that sets up per-repo config the other skills assume (issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs)
quote: Scaffold the per-repo configuration that the engineering skills assume: **Issue tracker**... **Triage labels**... **Domain docs**

text: Was accepted into Claude Code's official marketplace with a documented `claude plugins install` command
quote: `mattpocock-skills` was accepted into **Claude Code's official marketplace**... `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills` is now the documented route

text: Includes a skill that turns an agreed conversation into a written spec
quote: Turn an agreed conversation into a written spec.

text: Includes a skill that splits a spec into small tickets an agent can build
quote: Split a spec into small tickets an agent can build.

text: Includes a skill that builds a finished spec into code, test-first
quote: Build a finished spec into code, test-first.

text: Includes a skill that reviews a diff against your standards and the spec
quote: Review a diff against your standards and against the spec.

text: Includes a skill that charts a large effort as a map of decisions and settles them
quote: Chart a large effort as a map of decisions, and settle them.

text: Includes a skill that answers a design question with throwaway code you then delete
quote: Answer a design question with code you then delete.

text: Includes a skill that produces a cited answer read from primary sources
quote: Get a cited answer, read from primary sources.

text: Includes a skill that finds modules worth refactoring and outputs a visual report
quote: Find the modules worth refactoring, as a visual report.

text: Includes a skill that diagnoses a hard bug starting from a failing repro
quote: Diagnose a hard bug, starting from a repro that fails.

text: Includes a skill that resolves a merge or rebase conflict hunk by hunk
quote: Finish a merge or rebase conflict, hunk by hunk.

text: Includes a skill that generates a script walking a human through setup
quote: Generate a script that walks a human through setup.

text: Includes a skill that writes up a long session so another agent can pick it up later
quote: Write up a long session so another agent can continue it.

text: Includes a skill to help you figure out which skill applies to your current situation
quote: Find out which skill to use for the situation you are in.

text: Provides a CONTEXT.md-style document that helps agents decode project-specific jargon
quote: It's a document that helps agents decode the jargon used in the project.

text: Encourages working in vertical slices — one test then one implementation, repeated as tracer bullets
quote: Work in vertical slices instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a tracer bullet
